profile.headline: Software Developer & IT Professional | Experience in Software Development and IT Support
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with a B.S. in Software Development and a passion for building clean, user-focused applications across the web stack. My technical background spans full-stack development—working with React, JavaScript, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, and custom Shopify platforms.  

Driven by my faith in Christ, I approach software engineering with integrity, continuous learning, and a focus on solving real-world problems.  

Currently, I am expanding my backend and infrastructure skills by diving deep into C#, Python, SQL, and preparing for the Microsoft Cloud Associate Certification. Whether translating complex design files into responsive code, building web services, or running end-to-end quality assurance, I bring strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking to every project.  

Let's connect to discuss software engineering, web development, or cloud integrations!

positions.title: Tester Operator
positions.description:
• Managed the flashing and upgrading of OCMLs to enhance operational efficiency.  
• Updated, repaired, and worked on Cox cable gateways to ensure optimal performance.  
• Cleaned and restored Cox modems, contributing to improved customer and vendor satisfaction.  
• Conducted quality assurance testing on Cox Homelife devices, ensuring reliability and functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Microsoft Office · Pallet Jack · Windows · Software Troubleshooting · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Computer Repair · Data Entry · Quality Assurance · Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) · Powershell · Electronics · Android · Internet Protocol (IP)

positions.title: Fullstack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Built custom WordPress themes using PHP, Laravel, and Sage to deliver fast, maintainable sites.
- Designed and styled web applications with Sass, CSS, and Bootstrap 5 for responsive layouts.
- Performed quality assurance testing across mobile, tablet, and desktop to ensure consistent user experience.
- Converted Adobe Illustrator and XD designs into working, production‑ready web pages.
- Developed Shopify content and features using Liquid, JavaScript, jQuery, and JSON to support dynamic storefronts.
- Created side projects and applications with Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Ginger Grid, and SQLite on Linux systems to practice full‑stack development.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Laravel · Scrum · PHP · HTML5 · Linux · JavaScript · Software Documentation · Ruby · SASS · JSON · Chrome Developer Tools · Bootstrap · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · REST API · WordPress · Ruby on Rails · Back-End Web Development · Algorithms · Agile Methodologies · AJAX · Microsoft Visual Studio Code

positions.title: Travel Team Student Worker
positions.description: Logged flight and travel information in Excel and coordinated itineraries for prospective students and campus visitors.
positions.insights: Skills: Content Management Systems (CMS) · Teamwork · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Talent Systems Intern
positions.description:
- Performed quality assurance testing on the company’s web platform to identify and document issues before release.
- Built and updated frontend features using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 4, and jQuery to improve site functionality and design.
- Converted Figma UI designs into responsive, production‑ready web pages.
- Debugged and fixed layout and functionality issues using Chrome DevTools.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · HTML5 · jQuery · Bootstrap · CSS · Debugging

positions.title: Academic Web Services - Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Provided QA on web content and troubleshot software issues across the department’s systems.
• Assisted with Microsoft xRM case management and cross-team task coordination.

positions.title: GCU Tech Representative
positions.description: Resolved student technical support tickets and referrals, troubleshooting issues and coordinating with the broader support team.

positions.title: Snap Engineering Academy Scholars
positions.description:
• Selected as 1 of 15 (from 100+ applicants) for Snap’s 2020 Software Engineering Academy internship.
• Built frontend features with HTML/CSS/JavaScript and backend functionality with Firebase and Node.js.
• Worked with REST APIs to help scale a collaborative application built with EJS.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · CSS · jQuery · Git · Notion Productivity Software · Embedded JavaScript (EJS)
